articles.summary: We compare Type.ai, Sudowrite and Novelcrafter as tools for writing a full adult-fiction book. Type.ai is our top pick, with Sudowrite a close second; Novelcrafter’s results depend on the model you connect. We also test AI Smut Writer, ChatGPT, Claude and Grok on the same short smut prompt—and find AI Smut Writer the better fit for a quick scene.
articles.title: Best AI Smut Writer for Adult Fiction: Type.ai vs Sudowrite vs Novelcrafter

articles.summary: We tested seven AI story generators to find which ones help writers develop an idea, shape an outline and keep writing—not just generate a block of text. Type.ai was our pick for its outline-first workflow, while ChatGPT produced a decent short story when asked for a complete draft. Our focus was the writing process, not which AI model writes the best prose.
articles.title: Best AI Story Generator: We Tested 7 Tools for the Writing Workflow
